topic: earendil-works/pi Agent runtime, pi-coding-agent and Pi Agent Harness

timeframe.policy: evergreen official material may be retained when current applicability is verified

acceptance_gate: directly relevant to the specified Pi project or its runtime ecosystem
stable original URL or authorized stable platform object ID
original page, detail view, transcript, repository or discussion body was actually read
title and creator/account are verified; unknown dates are explicit
not a duplicate, mirror, trivial cross-post or search snippet
no access-control, privacy, copyright or platform-rule bypass

stop_conditions: all 47 platforms have a terminal coverage state and a current rule record
each complete platform has at least 10 independently reviewable accepted items
